manifest.author: LLM supervisor (session of Issue #25)
manifest.purpose: Accuracy on development sets stratified by number style, unit style, canonical style, phrasing family, mass unit, distractor.
manifest.hypothesis: Step-100 regression of both arms: if canonical-style accuracy fell, the shared optimizer-restart/warm-up shock disrupted a known skill; if only non-canonical strata are low, nothing was lost and the drop is a mixture effect.
manifest.read_scope: model copies; frozen development sets; never sealed
manifest.measurement_definitions: accuracy = argmax answer equals the gold answer; a stratum's rate is over the examples of the set having that attribute value
